strong.name: The Strongest
strong.description: Carried more than their fair share, every single day.

speedy.name: Speed Demon
speedy.description: First to camp, again and again.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Always had the right medicine, or the right words.

leader.name: Trail Leader
leader.description: Kept the group moving and the plan together.

strategist.name: Master Planner
strategist.description: Had a plan for everything, and a backup for that.

photographer.name: Photographer
photographer.description: Behind the camera for half of these photos.

dancer.name: Zumba Star
dancer.description: Danced it out at every rest stop.

chef.name: Chef
chef.description: Turned camp food into a feast.

joker.name: Joker
joker.description: Kept everyone laughing through the hardest climbs.

shopper.name: Personal Shopper
shopper.description: Knew where to find anything, anywhere.

gamer.name: Game Master
gamer.description: Ran the card games every single night.

teacher.name: Teacher
teacher.description: Always ready to explain, teach, or coach.

kind.name: Kind Heart
kind.description: The first to check in and the last to complain.

unstoppable.name: Never Gave Up
unstoppable.description: Finished every climb, no matter how hard.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.description: Not their first trip to the mountains.
